scenarios.prompt: An agent rewrites an EARS requirement 'WHEN 收到 SetConfig 请求 THE 配置模块 SHALL 在 50 ms 内返回结果' into the smoother sentence '配置模块会尽快响应 SetConfig 请求'.
expected: rejects the rewrite as a normative-layer violation, not a style preference
restores the EARS keywords and the 50 ms threshold verbatim
limits readability work to the surrounding explanation text

scenarios.prompt: An SRS contains 'NFR-003: 系统应快速响应，必要时重试'. The author asks to make the document more readable before R1.
expected: refuses to replace 快速/必要时 with another vague synonym
keeps the original text and registers a blocking Open Question for threshold, interval, and source
routes the gap to devflow-specify with an owner instead of resolving it by rewriting

scenarios.prompt: While improving readability of delta-spec.md, the agent reflows a MODIFIED operation's base excerpt from '校验失败时清空配置并继续启动。' into '原实现在校验失败后会清空配置，然后继续启动。'
expected: identifies the base excerpt as verbatim baseline evidence that must not change
reverts the rewrite so the digest comparison still holds
notes that canonical sync evidence breaks when excerpts are paraphrased

scenarios.prompt: During a readability pass on specs/design.md, the agent wants to rename the section heading '4.2 配置持久化' to '4.2 配置的持久化与恢复' because the new title reads better.
expected: treats the canonical heading as a stable display name rather than prose
requires a delta RENAMED operation with from/to and reference updates instead of an in-place edit
keeps stable entity keys and section numbering unchanged

scenarios.prompt: A delta-design.md reads fluently, but a reviewer cannot tell what stays unchanged without opening the source code.
expected: runs the five cold-read questions and records which one fails
classifies it as a readability defect when the fact exists but is hard to locate
classifies it as a content defect routed back to devflow-design when the fact is absent

scenarios.prompt: To make a sentence flow better, the agent adds a causal clause: '为避免弱网下打满连接池，本次把重试次数从 3 次改为 1 次'—the connection-pool reason appears nowhere in the source documents.
expected: flags the added rationale as an unsourced new assertion
removes it or confirms it with the author or upstream source first
keeps any confirmed content addition in a separate diff from the readability rewrite

scenarios.prompt: A design document refers to the same object as 会话, 链路, 连接, and session in different sections.
expected: unifies the term across the document and gives the Chinese-English pair on first use
adds a glossary with a forbidden-synonyms column when three or more terms are confusable
does not rename identifiers, error codes, or anything inside backticks

scenarios.prompt: The 数据迁移 section of delta-design.md says only '本节用于描述本次变更涉及的数据迁移与回滚方案'.
expected: flags template parroting because a reviewer cannot tell analysis from filler
requires either real content or a reviewable N/A with a concrete anchor
does not delete the section to hide unanalyzed risk

scenarios.prompt: One commit mixes a large readability rewrite with a threshold change from 50 ms to 80 ms and a new acceptance case.
expected: requires one diff one purpose: expression rewrite separate from content revision
asks the reviewer to treat the mixed diff as unresolved until it is split
keeps stable IDs, thresholds, and acceptance text out of the rewrite batch

scenarios.prompt: During R2, the reviewer finds long noun-heavy sentences and asks whether to just rewrite the section directly in the review context.
expected: keeps the reviewer read-only and produces findings instead of edits
assigns severity by reader risk: ambiguity is critical, cold-read failure is important, wording is minor
routes the rework back to the author stage with a Resolution slot

scenarios.prompt: A reviewer wants to block R1 because some Chinese and English words are missing a space and a few headings could be shorter, while the requirements themselves are testable and unambiguous.
expected: classifies spacing and heading wording as minor and non-blocking
keeps the gate decision based on testability and unambiguity
still requires a Resolution entry for accepted minor findings

scenarios.prompt: The agent proposes to polish change.json field values and to reword a reviewer's finding text in reviews/r1-review-2026-09-03.md so the archive reads better.
expected: excludes change.json and other structured files from readability work
keeps reviewer wording, verdict, severity, and Resolution text verbatim on disk
allows a separately labeled readable summary in handoff notes only

scenarios.prompt: An agent finishes a readability pass over srs.md and reports 'documentation is now much clearer' with no other evidence.
expected: rejects the vague self-check and requires a concrete doc_readability_check
requires ID counts, numbers with units, backtick contents, and SHALL/Given/When/Then counts to match before and after
reverts the pass when any comparison fails instead of arguing the rewrite is equivalent

scenarios.prompt: A specification writes '超时50ms', '使用CRC32校验', 'P99响应时间基本不超过50', and uses half-width punctuation in Chinese sentences.
expected: adds spacing between Chinese and Latin/digits and normalizes full-width punctuation
keeps identifiers and error codes in backticks and unchanged
treats the missing unit and statistical basis in 'P99 基本不超过 50' as a content defect for devflow-specify rather than a formatting fix
